high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "index.daily," which is located in Bangalore, India. The post is part of a series, as indicated by the number "05" at the top left corner and the rating "6/10" at the top right corner. The main content of the post discusses the Y2K bug, a significant technological issue that occurred around the year 2000 due to the way some computer systems were programmed to handle dates. The text explains how governments and big corporations from Western countries panicked about a possible mass system outage on December 31st, 1
